generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and condition are as per KW-1 tender document and General Conditions Separate Sheet uploaded

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Work done Certificate Satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor, at least one any nature of work of value not less than Rs.2.62 lakhs in any one year. -usually not less than 25Percentage of the estimated value of contract. 2021-22 to 2025-26

To qualify for award of the Contract, each bidder should have attained in the last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 achieved an average of financial turnover, Turnover certificate with Profit and loss statements and IT returns, in any one year in all classes of civil engineering construction works only, not less than the Amount put to tender, Rs.10.48 Lakhs.

Tenderer must have liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs.3.14 Lakhs Credit lines/ letter of credit/certificates from banks for meeting the fund requirement etc. issued the Nationalised bank should be furnished by the contractor And LOC issued by such a bank should be of unconditional nature. Conditional LOC not accepted
Ongoing work details most attached with self attested if falls information submitted tender will be rejected
